tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tables and the side rail.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented-control tracks, finding rows and the search bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, inputs and chips. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface (13.6:1 dark, 15.9:1 light at worst).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps, IDs. At least 6:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and the emphasised word in a heading.

tokens.name: brand-mark
tokens.usage: Stroke of the shield logo.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Fill of a person's mark (the only actor that can decide). Always carries ink-on-seal text.

tokens.name: ink-on-seal
tokens.usage: Initials and text on seal (16.7:1).

tokens.name: seal-ring
tokens.usage: Outlines for a pending sign-off, the current lifecycle step and checkboxes. 5:1 or better.

tokens.name: seal-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge around seal fills so they hold their shape on light surfaces.

tokens.name: actor-system
tokens.usage: Square mark for deterministic system jobs (triage, routing).

tokens.name: actor-agent
tokens.usage: Dashed ring and dashed frame for AI agents and their drafts.

tokens.name: agent-text
tokens.usage: Text labels inside an agent frame.

tokens.name: agent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an agent draft header or ledger row.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. One per view.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action (16.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px.

tokens.name: tier-low
tokens.usage: Low risk tier, as text on any surface.

tokens.name: tier-medium
tokens.usage: Medium risk tier, as text on any surface.

tokens.name: tier-high
tokens.usage: High risk tier and overdue dates, as text on any surface.

tokens.name: tier-critical
tokens.usage: Critical risk tier, as text on any surface.

tokens.name: dial-low
tokens.usage: Risk dial segment 1. 3:1 or better on panels.

tokens.name: dial-medium
tokens.usage: Risk dial segment 2.

tokens.name: dial-high
tokens.usage: Risk dial segment 3.

tokens.name: dial-critical
tokens.usage: Risk dial segment 4.

tokens.name: dial-off
tokens.usage: Unlit dial segments. Decorative; the tier name is always shown as text.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Verified, passing, signed.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Paused, needs attention.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small marks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense screens; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main content padding.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any control you can press.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, search bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and question tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels: triage, answer card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter pills, progress steps.
